T: Run like the wind. Bake like your mum.
D: Two young sprinters from Western Australia sign up and head for Gallipoli.
P: Serve the biscuits when Archy and Frank meet at the athletics carnival.
S: Cairo market hummus and baba ganoush
Chickpea hummus and smoky eggplant dip, flatbread, dukkah, olives, cucumber

Hummus, baba ganoush and warm flatbread with dukkah, olives and cucumber, a dusting of paprika and plenty of olive oil. Blitz a drained tin of chickpeas with 3 tbsp tahini, lemon, garlic and iced water until silky. Char an eggplant over a flame, scoop and mash with tahini and lemon. Serve with warm flatbreads, dukkah, olives, cucumber, paprika and olive oil.
Archy's WA cheese and chive damper
the station in WA where Archy trains with Uncle Jack

A crusty round of damper studded with tasty cheese and chives, baked golden and torn open warm with salted butter. Rub 60g cold butter into 450g self-raising flour and 1 tsp salt. Stir in 120g grated tasty cheese and a handful of chopped chives. Add 300ml milk and mix with a knife into a soft dough. Shape a round on a floured tray, cut a cross on top and scatter with 30g more cheese. Bake at 200C for 30 minutes until it sounds hollow. Serve warm with butter.
M: Frank and Archy's Cairo kofta wraps
Frank and Archy meet again near the pyramids

Spiced lamb kofta grilled over high heat, wrapped in warm flatbread with garlic yoghurt, tomato and cucumber salad, pickled chilli and sumac onions. Mix 700g lamb mince with 1 grated onion, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp paprika, chopped parsley and salt. Shape onto 8 skewers and chill 30 minutes. Slice 1 red onion and toss with 1 tsp sumac. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with 1 crushed garlic clove and lemon. Dice 2 tomatoes and 1 cucumber. Grill the kofta 8 to 10 minutes, turning. Wrap in 4 warm flatbreads with everything else.
Garlic and rosemary roast lamb leg, roast potatoes and pumpkin, peas, gravy

Lamb leg studded with garlic and rosemary, roasted at 180C to 58C, rested, with roast potatoes, pumpkin, peas and gravy. Stud a 2kg lamb leg with garlic and rosemary and roast at 180C until 58C inside. Rest 20 minutes. Roast 800g potatoes and 600g pumpkin alongside. Cook 300g peas and make gravy from the pan juices.
W: Soft dumplings simmered in golden syrup sauce, served with cream
Scone dough dumplings dropped into simmering golden syrup, butter and water, covered and cooked 20 minutes until puffed. Cream or ice cream.
Crisp oat and coconut cookies sweetened with golden syrup
Rolled oats, flour, coconut and sugar mixed with melted butter, golden syrup and bicarb dissolved in boiling water, rolled, flattened, baked at 160C for 15 minutes.
K: Strong black tea boiled in a pot, tin mugs, milk and plenty of sugar

Strong black tea boiled in a billy for a minute, settled, poured into tin mugs with milk and plenty of sugar. Boil 1.2L water in a billy or pot. Add 3 tbsp loose leaf tea, boil for a minute and swing to settle. Pour into tin mugs with milk and plenty of sugar.

d.note: A nip before stand to at dawn.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 5 days in a tin

steps.text: Mix the oats, flour, coconut and sugar in a bowl.
Melt the butter with the golden syrup, then stir in the bicarb dissolved in the boiling water.
Combine, roll into balls and flatten on lined trays.
Bake at 160C until golden.

dishes.n: Cairo market hummus and baba ganoush
dishes.make_ahead: Dips up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Char the eggplant over a flame until collapsed and blackened inside.
Blitz the drained chickpeas with the tahini, lemon juice, garlic and iced water until silky.
Scoop out the eggplant flesh and mash with a little more tahini and lemon.
Warm the flatbreads and serve everything on a platter with dukkah, olives, sliced cucumber, paprika and olive oil.

dishes.make_ahead: Stud the lamb with garlic and rosemary up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; roast on the day

steps.text: Stud the lamb with sliced garlic and rosemary. Peel and cut the potatoes and pumpkin.
Roast the lamb at 180C until 58C inside, adding the potatoes and pumpkin for the last hour.
Rest the lamb under foil.
Cook the peas, and make gravy by simmering the pan juices with the stock.

veg.n: "As fast as a leopard" nut roast
veg.make_ahead: Shape the roast up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Fry the onion, crushed garlic, mushrooms and chopped rosemary in half the oil until dry and golden.
Mix with the nuts, lentils, breadcrumbs, cheddar and eggs and press into a lined loaf tin. Peel and cut the potatoes and pumpkin and toss in the rest of the oil.
Roast the nut roast and vegetables at 190C until the roast is firm and browned.
Rest the roast in the tin, then turn out and slice.
Cook the peas, and make gravy by cooking the flour in the roasting tray, then whisking in the stock and soy sauce.

dishes.make_ahead: Best cooked just before serving; rub in the butter and make the dough up to 3 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Rub a portion of the butter into the flour and mix in the milk to a soft dough.
Bring the water, brown sugar, golden syrup and remaining butter to a simmer.
Drop in spoonfuls of dough, cover and cook gently.
Serve with the sauce and cream.

dishes.make_ahead: Best brewed fresh; nothing to make ahead

steps.text: Boil the water in a billy or pot.
Add the tea, boil for a minute and swing to settle.
Pour into tin mugs with milk and plenty of sugar.

w.note: Soft dumplings simmered in golden syrup sauce, served with cream
w.how: Rub 30g butter into 150g self-raising flour and mix in 100ml milk to a soft dough. Bring 375ml water, 100g brown sugar, 3 tbsp golden syrup and 30g butter to a simmer. Drop in spoonfuls of dough, cover and cook 20 minutes. Serve with cream.

w.note: Crisp oat and coconut cookies sweetened with golden syrup
w.how: Mix 90g oats, 150g flour, 85g coconut and 150g brown sugar. Melt 125g butter with 2 tbsp golden syrup, then add 1 tsp bicarb dissolved in 2 tbsp boiling water. Stir together, roll into balls, flatten and bake at 160C for 15 minutes.
